Hi Samantha — thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed next step so we can lock in the right folks on both sides.

Recap (2‑line):
- BrightLeaf is prioritizing low-latency inference for user-facing features and needs predictable cost controls (esp. < 50ms 95th for short prompts).
- You want a hands-on technical session to validate latency, routing options, and our quantization/kv-cache tradeoffs with your infra team.

Proposed next step:
- 75‑minute technical immersion (ML + infra) — we find 75 minutes lets us cover architecture, a short live run, and Q&A without rushing.
- Audience: your infra lead + 1 ML engineer + product manager (please confirm names).
- Goals: validate perf baseline, discuss model variants and routing policy, align on pilot scope + runbook.

Suggested agenda (attached as PDF):
1) 10m — Introductions & goals
2) 20m — High-level architecture map & routing options
3) 25m — Live demo: small perf run + KV cache behavior
4) 15m — Quantization & cost tradeoffs + autoscale patterns
5) 5m — Next steps / mutual action items

Attachments: redwood-75min-agenda.pdf [attachment stub]
Calendly poll: https://calendly.com/redwood/laura-ml-infra-75min (alternate times below if calendly isn't convenient)

Availability options (PT):
- Tue May 4: 10:00–11:15 or 14:00–15:15
- Thu May 6: 09:30–10:45 or 16:00–17:15
- Mon May 10: 10:00–11:15 (preferred for our infra team)

Prep / pre-reads: we attached a one‑page agenda and a checklist — items to have available: sample prompt/traffic profile, a contact for network/security for any connectivity questions, and any SOC2/infosec questions you want us to address in session.

If you can reply with preferred slot + who will join from your side, we’ll send a calendar invite and add a short perf checklist so the live run is useful.

Thanks — looking forward.

— Laura
